baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory. Baseline sources and Cargo files checked against git, and both fixture copies checked byte-for-byte before measurement.
updated_engine: Working-tree streaming single-trail cursors through intermediate WITH SKIP/LIMIT. Page counters span upstream rows, skipped projections are guarded, admitted rows freeze their scope, and the last admitted row drains downstream expansions before stopping ancestors.
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, fixture and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, per-row validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup.
fixture: A chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop. page-trails: depth 14 (32766 potential trails), SKIP 2 LIMIT 10 before range(1,128), yields 1280 rows. page-members: depth 10 (2046 potential trails), range(1,128), SKIP 64 LIMIT 128 across parents, then range(source,source+127), yields 16384 rows. page-all: depth 10, range(1,32), then SKIP 0, yields all 65472 rows. Full consumption validates total multiplicity, member counts, conditional member sums and squares for page-members, and per-depth histograms/member sums/squares for page-all. Every row checks hop count against endpoint and member bounds. Unordered pages make no cross-mode promise about selected trail depths; bounded-page validation checks the scalar bags independently of that choice. First mode consumes and validates one row. Options permit 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload; scalar outputs exclude hydration.

queries.page-trails: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH length(p) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint SKIP 2 LIMIT 10 UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS member RETURN hops,endpoint,member
queries.page-members: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS source WITH length(p) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint,source SKIP $skip LIMIT $fanout UNWIND range(source,source+$fanout-1) AS member RETURN hops,endpoint,source,member
queries.page-all: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH length(p) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS member WITH hops,endpoint,member SKIP 0 RETURN hops,endpoint,member
